episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: And I've wondered, what's this all gonna be like for Naja?
Somehow, back then, I never really imagined there would be a day when I might get to just ask her.
Okay, your mom told me she didn't know if you had read the article about choosing your elementary school.
No, you've never read that article.
I've never found myself to read it.
Maybe I should, because of my mom.
Well, also because it's about you.
Oh, yeah, but I never read it.
Naja has been listening to her mom give talks her whole life.
